description: A React component file implementing syntax highlighting and code block rendering using prism-react-renderer and Emotion CSS-in-JS. Contains components for rendering code snippets with optional line highlighting and collapsing features.

methods.name: getRanges
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of lines or line ranges into an array of Range objects.

methods.name: parseClassName
methods.description: Parses the className string to extract language, highlight ranges, and collapse ranges for syntax highlighting.

methods.name: findRange
methods.description: Finds a range object including a specific line number.

methods.name: CodeBlock
methods.description: Renders a code block or inline code based on the content, using the Code component for blocks.

methods.name: Code
methods.description: Renders syntax-highlighted code with optional collapsing and highlighting, using prism-react-renderer.

methods.name: InlineCode
methods.description: Renders an inline code snippet with styling.
